skill.summary: Agent project directory structure规范。指导agent生成规范的项目文件结构，包括：项目文件单独存放在项目目录下，日志文件统一放在log目录，临时文件（截图、缓存等）与正式文件分离。使用时检查现有结构是否符合规范，或根据规范创建/调整目录结构。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added explicit instructions specifying trigger phrases (in both Chinese and English) that activate this skill by default.
- Clarified that the standard project structure should be used unless the user requests an alternative.
- No code or logic changes; documentation only.
